title: bin's proofs reach the temp directory only through the scratch door
intention: bin's proofs reach the system temp directory only through the scratch door, and bin proves that of its own proofs dir by calling the scratch tool's published scan.
why: Peer F31 (2026-10-08): a third routing ticket, the same shape as 017d8298662a and b2abaa16e590. The corpus scan (test_scratch.py test_no_proof_in_this_repo_calls_mkdtemp_bare, the scan b4d39f3610f3 publishes as bare_temp_reach) run at cairn f7cd3b33 names, as bin's one offender, 'bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py:217: d = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="proofgate_fixture_proof_")) / "proofs"' — landed 2026-10-06 in 16d179a2 by CC's own 1af0564c0db3 red proof. Under RULE 1 bin proves its own proofs clean at its own address.
traces_to: RULE 1 (bin proves its own proofs clean by calling the scratch tool's public scan; the scratch tool names no caller) and Law 4 (the scratch door is physics for bin only when a sealed tooth at bin's own address reds a bare reach).
how: bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py:217 (_fixture_proofs) takes its directory from cairn.tools.scratch.scratch.scratch_dir('proofgate_fixture_proof_') instead of tempfile.mkdtemp, every tooth keeping its assertion. bin/proofs gains one tooth that calls scratch.bare_temp_reach on bin's own directory and asserts the result is empty; proven_by is that tooth.

Horizon: the corpus tooth goes green once 017d8298662a, b2abaa16e590 and this ticket have all landed, and a future bare mkdtemp added under bin/proofs reds this tooth at bin's own address.

decisions.text: D1 (folds the falsifier, gates_bound and question open-7095f2b059a1's N/A clause; peer F29/F30): the hollow APPLIES. It reverts the build's edit to bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py to the pre-build commit, and the new tooth test_no_proof_in_bin_reaches_temp_bare reds, because bare_temp_reach names bin/proofs/test_proof_gate.py:217 again. The new tooth file is the instrument and is not reverted. proven_by is bin/proofs/test_bins_proofs_reach_temp_only_through_the_scratch_door.py; the hollow is run with bin/cairn test --hollow 7afb00d72c6c --seal after PROVEME. The earlier assumption that a proofs-only build leaves the hollow nothing to revert is wrong: the hollow reverts proof files that are not this ticket's instrument (hollow.py:435/:539).
